name: IEC inductive proximity sensor: ferrous proximity switch, normally open
aliases: inductive proximity sensor Ferrous Proximity Switch, Normally Open
summary: Inductive proximity sensor form: Ferrous Proximity Switch, Normally Open.
description: An inductive proximity sensor detects a metallic target through the effect it has on an electromagnetic sensing field. This entry identifies the ferrous proximity switch, normally open form in the publisher's IEC-context family.

A metal flag on a carriage can produce a controller input without touching a mechanical switch. The normally-open designation starts with a non-conducting output or open contact in the documented reference condition; operation changes that state.
Target material, sensing distance and output circuit are product properties; an inductive mark does not identify PNP, NPN or a universal terminal assignment.
